notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. The 1985 RD is `RD report-name-1 [CODE literal-1] [CONTROL ...] [PAGE ...]`. CODE IS (report-code-is-2002) and the PAGE clause's 2002 forms (report-page-forms-2002: page width, integer-1 omitted, LAST CONTROL HEADING / LAST CH, FIRST DE / LAST DE, IS before a phrase's integer) are refused at 85. `PAGE IS 60` and `PAGE ARE 60` are COBOL-85 (§1985:XIII.3.8.2: only PAGE is underlined in the bracket, the PDF page rendered), so they compile. Witnesses: 1985-FMT-XIII_3_5_2, pb5242-page-forms-85 and pb5242-code-is-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985 RD: 'RD report-name-1 [CODE literal-1] [CONTROL ...] [PAGE LIMIT integer-1 LINE [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]]' (§1985:XIII.3.5.2). 2023 RD is 'RD report-name-1 [IS GLOBAL] [code-clause] [control-clause] [page-clause]' (§2023:13.14.2); IS GLOBAL is no change, 1985 already has it (§1985:X.4.4.2). CONTROL is unchanged (§2023:13.18.16.2). But CODE now takes 'CODE IS {literal-1 | identifier-1}' (§2023:13.18.12.2), and PAGE adds a COLS/COLUMNS width with integer-1 optional (§2023:13.18.39.2; 'Either integer-1 or integer-2 or both shall be specified', §2023:13.18.39.3 SR2; phrases only with integer-1, SR3), LAST CONTROL HEADING and the DE/CH synonyms (§2023:13.18.39.3 SR1). 1985 entries keep their meaning; 2023 accepts entries the 1985 format refuses (looser).
